entries.0015c3a13fd9a266: This business manufactures, purchases and sells high-silica products (refined silica stone powder and others). The Shikamachi Plant and the Emukae Plant, both in Sasebo City, Nagasaki Prefecture, are the production facilities for this business. Revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,948 million.
entries.0095ec1d838b1aaa: It supplies products to shipyards, steel and heavy electrical manufacturers, semiconductor-related manufacturers and others. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, Oshima Shipbuilding Co., Ltd. was the major customer, accounting for 29.5% of revenue.
entries.0996fe771db9bd18: A manufacturer headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, with a machinery business including marine equipment, a resource business in high silica, and a materials business including heat-resistant paints.
entries.0c0fc0e13a388fdf: It states that it is promoting the development of new high-purity products utilizing its crushing technology, and continuing research and development on environment-related materials based on its own materials and on higher purity for refined silica powder.
entries.1a604c7e36c7c403: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,381 million, a decrease of 4.8% from the previous year. Revenue by business was ¥6,492 million for the Machinery Business, ¥1,948 million for the Resources Business, ¥797 million for the Materials Business and ¥143 million for the Real Estate Business.
entries.1bd145391faf307a: Sales income from heat-resistant paints and Rainatex
entries.1c7f1152df90d31c: This is a business model centered on the design and manufacture of industrial machinery such as marine equipment and air preheaters, together with the manufacture and sale of refined silica powder, Haishirika, the sale of heat-resistant paints and high-purity natural rubber, and the leasing of office buildings.
entries.28b48d7b0e6f39a9: It designs and manufactures general industrial machinery such as marine equipment and air preheaters, and designs and manufactures plant-related equipment as well as installing, constructing and supervising machinery; it also manufactures and sells Haishirika refined silica powder, and through subsidiaries handles heat-resistant paints and high-purity natural rubber.
entries.31051b32d8db1d8f: Product sales and construction income from machinery-related business
entries.339f1229bf73bc64: This business designs and manufactures marine equipment, air preheaters and other general industrial machinery, manufactures plant-related equipment, and carries out installation, construction and supervision of machinery and equipment.
entries.34a7e328e2afe6e7: This business handles heat-resistant paints and Linatex (high-purity natural rubber).
entries.358e36b46b897799: The medium-term management plan 'Shin Nitchitsu 2025' sets as its basic policy the rebuilding of the management foundation through enhancing resilience (strengthening on-site capabilities) by means of proactive investment and taking on new business domains (allocating resources to growth businesses), and sets as its basic management strategies focused investment in production facilities, accelerated investment in human capital, and initiatives in decarbonization and the environment as well as challenges in new business domains.
entries.3ef5def11f08811b: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥194 million, a decrease of 19.6% from the previous year.
entries.4cd6fa8a94186fce: This business designs and manufactures marine equipment, air preheaters and other general industrial machinery, manufactures plant-related equipment, and carries out installation, construction and supervision of machinery and equipment. The Matsuura Plant in Matsuura City and the Emukae Plant in Sasebo City, both in Nagasaki Prefecture, are the production facilities for this business. Revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,492 million.
entries.7521997f8a55de50: It traces its origins to a mining company founded in Korea in 1929, and was established in 1950 by taking over domestic assets. Headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, it forms a group with three consolidated subsidiaries, with consolidated headcount of 268 as of March 31, 2026.
entries.803aa02876eebb4c: The segment information shows, as external customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, ¥6,492,125 thousand for the Machinery Business, ¥1,948,269 thousand for the Resources Business, ¥797,722 thousand for the Materials Business and ¥143,276 thousand for the Real Estate Business, totaling ¥9,381,394 thousand.

entries.9d2cb6a57e2037f4: This business leases office buildings. The facility is a rental office building in Minato-ku, Tokyo, and its management is outsourced to outside parties. Revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥143 million.
entries.d1a48dc2838a1b1d: This business handles heat-resistant paints and Linatex (high-purity natural rubber). Heat-resistant paints are manufactured and sold by consolidated subsidiary Tokyo Netsu Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd., and Linatex is purchased, processed and sold by consolidated subsidiary Sansen Kiko Co., Ltd. Sansen Kiko Co., Ltd. also engages in can manufacturing and the manufacture and sale of machinery. Revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥797 million.
